verdict.rationale: Mistral's docs describe a defined per-model lifecycle (release to retirement) and instruct developers to use lifecycle stages to plan migrations before retirement, plus a models API for listing/retrieving specific model IDs, implying some notion of versioned models. However, the evidence never explicitly documents an alias-to-version mapping mechanism (e.g., how a 'latest' alias resolves to a pinned version) or a policy describing when aliases move to new versions. Missing for 10: explicit alias naming/versioning scheme docs, alias-to-version mapping policy, confirmation that pinning an exact version ID is supported alongside a tracking alias.
